a404638457.headline: Rockstar puts the GTA 6 map online for Leonida fans
a404638457.full_caption:
Leonida is now viewable before you've cleared a single patch of fog. 🗺️

According to a report, Rockstar has put the GTA 6 map online. That means you can look over the setting before you start exploring it yourself. We only have the headline so far, so details are thin. We'll share more once the specifics are clear.

Will you study the map before launch, or keep it a surprise and explore blind?

Source: MIXED News

6cc33cac35.headline: GTA 6: Where to Buy Arthur Morgan's Hat from RDR2
6cc33cac35.full_caption:
Yeehaw, Leonida! 🤠 An Arthur Morgan-style hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 can be bought in GTA 6, and it only costs $35.

It's sold at a daytime yard sale in southern Port Gellhorn, as the Genuine Cowboy Hat. Only one of your two protagonists can buy it, so choose who wears it. Swipe for the full steps.

Who's getting the cowboy hat, Jason or Lucia?

Source: VGC

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTAVI #Leonida #PortGellhorn #RedDeadRedemption2 #ArthurMorgan #RockstarGames #GTAEasterEgg #GTA6Guide
6cc33cac35.alt_text: Graphic for a GTA 6 guide showing where to buy a cowboy hat like Arthur Morgan's from Red Dead Redemption 2.

slides.title: Where to find it
slides.text: Head to a blue house on the southern edge of Port Gellhorn, a short distance south of Moses' chop shop. It hosts a yard sale, and the hat is among the items.

slides.title: When and what you need
slides.text: The yard sale only runs during the daytime. It becomes available from Chapter 2 onwards, so make enough story progress first.

slides.title: Price and item name
slides.text: Look for the Genuine Cowboy Hat. It costs just $35, and once bought it appears in your wardrobe with your other clothes.

slides.title: Pick your wearer
slides.text: Each yard sale item, the hat included, can only be bought by one of your protagonists. Decide whether Jason or Lucia gets it before you buy.
